title: Senate begins examining the 2027 state budget after Assembly rejection
detail: The Senate opened debate on the 2027 state budget on 20 November (running to 9 December), after the social security bill was debated from 16 to 18 November. The upper house aims to hold the 2027 deficit to 5% of GDP and Senate leader Gérard Larcher rejected tax increases. PM Sébastien Lecornu has ruled out a special law, saying answers will come after the Senate review in December.
